title: Huang out as Nvidia CEO, SEC probe reported
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: AFP, citing the New York Times, reports the SEC inquiry into Nvidia's accounting is at an early stage and its focus is unclear, and says chair Harvey Jones has ruled out Huang's return although Trump called on Fri 20 Nov for him to be reinstated. Colette Kress is interim CEO and no permanent CEO has been named; Huang faces closed-door House interviews on 1 Dec, and Reuters reports he has also agreed to a public Senate Banking hearing that has no date yet.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: House committees' closed-door interview with Huang
sources: Reuters, New York Times, AFP, WSJ, New Straits Times, Yahoo Finance, CBS News, TechCrunch

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: AFP reports two tankers were struck in Hormuz on Sat 21 Nov and that Bahrain accused Iran of hitting an industrial site; Euronews counts at least three tankers attacked and reports more than 14 Iranian tankers readied off Kharg Island to run the US blockade. Iran held talks with a Qatari delegation, but Foreign Minister Araghchi said talks on Hormuz are pointless until Iran's demands are met, and no convoy has sailed and no ceasefire has been confirmed.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: AFP, Business Recorder, Euronews, Iran International, Al Jazeera, Ynet, Gulf News, CoinDesk

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: CoinGlass data show bitcoin near $60,700 on Sun 22 Nov, after Altcoin Buzz says it touched about $55,100 on Sat, its lowest since September 2024. Bitcoin.com News says Strategy's 850,849 BTC sit about $12.6B below their $75,452 average cost and that Saylor has hinted at another purchase; MSCI's deletion takes effect after the close on 30 Nov, and whether other index providers follow is still open.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, CoinGlass, Bitcoin.com News, Crypto.news, Altcoin Buzz, Investing.com, Coinspeaker

title: Binance $6.3B hack, stolen ETH on the move
since_label: Thu 29 Oct 00:00 UTC, before the hack was reported
status: Elliptic's 20 Nov update, covered by Bitcoin.com News and The Cryptonomist, says the hackers emptied five of the nine largest ETH addresses from 17 to 20 Nov, moving about 488,000 ETH ($860M) into batches of about 12,000 ETH and swapping some into bitcoin through THORChain, while the 18,270 stolen BTC have not moved and only a negligible amount has been cashed out. Reuters reports an Abu Dhabi court has ordered 18 firms, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, to keep the tokens frozen, and a hearing on 1 Dec will decide whether the freeze continues.
why: Stolen ETH that no issuer can freeze is being moved and swapped, a supply overhang for ETH and alts while crypto sentiment sits at extreme fear.
next_label: Abu Dhabi court hearing on the freeze order
sources: Elliptic, Reuters, Bitcoin.com News, The Cryptonomist, Cointribune, CryptoSlate, Decrypt, Binance

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Yahoo Finance and Seeking Alpha data show ANT closed Fri 20 Nov at $88.91, down 8.5% from its $97.17 debut close, after touching $83.05 against the $83 IPO price, then slipped to $87.79 after hours; TradingView lists a WSJ report on bankers trading blame over the fall in market value. Finviz lists leveraged and inverse ANT ETFs starting to trade Monday; whether ANT holds its IPO price and when it enters the Nasdaq 100 are still open.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
next_label: Leveraged ANT ETFs list, Monday session
sources: Yahoo Finance, Seeking Alpha, CNBC, CNN, WSJ, Morningstar, Finviz, Investing.com
